## Summary
Makes the eventual integration a **copy-paste operator procedure** and proves there is nothing to fear in it, and bumps versions to **0.1.0** — while **merging nothing, tagging nothing, and not touching `main` or any branch** (operator rule; HG-05 is a post-chain operator action). Stacked on `devin/p20-2-spec-reconciliation` (PR #53).

Implements `docs/tickets/P20.3__integration-release.md` via the `implement-spec` skill (`live_verification=true`) and folds in the two carried P20.2 docs follow-ups.

## What changed
- **`docs/build/tools/merge_dryrun.sh`** — read-only, idempotent merge dry-run over all open PRs (throwaway detached worktree at `origin/main`, `git merge --no-commit --no-ff` per PR, bottom-up accumulation asserting the top-PR tree, `git worktree remove --force`). Exits non-zero on any conflict. **Result now: 27/27 open PRs (#27–#53) merge clean, bottom-up tree == PR #53; `main`/`origin/main` unchanged; worktree list back to 1; `git tag -l` empty.**
- **`docs/build/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`** §(a) PR graph + SHAs, §(b) the dry-run table, §(c) three strategies (merge-commit bottom-up = default), §(d) the copy-pasteable operator procedure incl. `git tag -a v0.1.0` + `gh release create` + branch-protection `gh api`, §(e) rollback, §(f) post-merge verification.
- **Version bump to 0.1.0** across all 14 members (+ `web/`); `uv.lock` refreshed; `make check` green.
- **`RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.0.md`** (states what is **not** live; licence posture; capstone verdict), **`CITATION.cff`**, **`CHANGELOG.md`** (Keep-a-Changelog), **`CONTRIBUTING.md`** (stacked-ticket workflow, `make check`, spec-amendment rule, licence headers); **README** refresh (14 members incl. `evidence/`, `docs/build/`, releases; fixed stale 668/8,888 → 671/9,047 and the licence-placeholder/skeleton claims).
- **Manifest** phase-gate line; **traceability** P20.3 section; **risk register** RISK-P20-03/04/05.
- **Carried P20.2 follow-ups:** root **`AGENTS.md`** SIG-ENG-039 rule (add an ADR's Appendix F row in the same PR); **Load/AC citation touch-ups** on the 12 tickets amended/folded-back by P20.2 (SIG-UI-047 / SIG-EVID-020 / SIG-ENG-039 + A1–A7) — cite, not copy.
- **`CI_STATUS.md`** is added in a follow-up commit once this branch's CI run completes.

## Design decisions
- `merge_dryrun.sh` re-execs into a full (non-POSIX) bash so `sh …` works on bash-3.2 / bash-in-POSIX-mode; cleanup calls `git worktree remove --force` directly (macOS `/tmp`→`/private/tmp` symlink defeats a path-grep guard).
- Web version bumped in both `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to keep `npm ci` in sync.
